title.zh-TW: 每月首階消費最高 3% 現金回饋（VIP 4%）
title.en: Up to 3% cash back on monthly spending (4% for VIP)

text.zh-TW: Core 首 $2,000、Luxe 首 $10,000、Pinnacle 首 $50,000 為 3%；VIP 首 $50,000 為 4%。
text.en: 3% on the first $2,000 (Core), $10,000 (Luxe) or $50,000 (Pinnacle); 4% on the first $50,000 for VIP.

title.zh-TW: Core 方案免費，含 1 張免費虛擬卡
title.en: Core tier is free, with 1 free virtual card

text.zh-TW: 實體卡 50 美元；升級方案可解鎖更多免費卡片與回饋。
text.en: The physical card costs $50; higher tiers unlock more free cards and rewards.

title.zh-TW: 指定訂閱分類最高 30% 回饋
title.en: Up to 30% back on selected subscriptions

text.zh-TW: AI、串流、外送會員等；Luxe 10%、Pinnacle 20%、VIP 30%，每月分別封頂 10、20、30 美元。
text.en: AI, streaming, delivery memberships and more; 10% (Luxe), 20% (Pinnacle), 30% (VIP), capped at $10, $20 and $30 per month.

title.zh-TW: 機場貴賓室單次券 100% 回饋（2026/10/20 起）
title.en: 100% back on airport lounge single-entry vouchers (from 2026/10/20)

text.zh-TW: Luxe 每年 2 次；Pinnacle 與 VIP 不限次數（每天 1 次）。
text.en: Twice a year for Luxe; unlimited for Pinnacle and VIP (one per day).

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結，並依指示建立 ether.fi 帳號與錢包。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link, then create your ether.fi account and wallet as instructed.

steps.zh-TW: 依畫面指示申請 Cash Card；方案解鎖條件見上方說明。
steps.en: Apply for the Cash Card as prompted; see the description above for the tier unlock requirements.

steps.zh-TW: 依平台規定完成身分驗證，並確認所在地可以申請。
steps.en: Complete identity verification as the platform requires, and check that you are eligible where you live.

intro.zh-TW: 以太坊質押協議 ether.fi 推出的 DeFi 原生信用卡：非託管錢包、質押收益，每月首階消費享 3% 現金回饋（VIP 4%）。
intro.en: A DeFi-native credit card from ether.fi: non-custodial wallet, staking yield and 3% cash back on the first tier of monthly spending (4% for VIP).

description.zh-TW:
ether.fi Cash Card（正式名稱 Ether.fi Cash Card）是由以太坊質押協議 ether.fi 推出的加密貨幣信用卡，主打非託管錢包、理財質押收益與消費現金回饋。

方案與回饋（取自第三方文章整理，實際以 ether.fi 官方公告為準）：

- **Core**：免費；首 $2,000／月消費 3% 現金回饋；1 張免費虛擬卡，實體卡 50 美元。
- **Luxe**：消費點數 5,000 點、存入 Liquid 15,000 美元、質押 30,000 顆 ETHFI 或年費 199 美元／年解鎖；首 $10,000／月 3%；指定訂閱分類回饋 10%（每月封頂 10 美元）；機場貴賓室單次券每年 2 次；2 張免費虛擬卡、1 張免費實體卡。
- **Pinnacle**：消費點數 25,000 點、存入 Liquid 100,000 美元、質押 150,000 顆 ETHFI 或年費 999 美元／年解鎖；首 $50,000／月 3%；分類回饋 20%（每月封頂 20 美元）；ATM 每月 10 次免手續費；貴賓室單次券不限次數（每天 1 次）；專屬客戶經理。
- **VIP**（僅邀請制）：首 $50,000／月 4%；分類回饋 30%（每月封頂 30 美元）；ATM 每月 10 次免手續費；專屬支援。
description.en:
The ether.fi Cash Card (officially Ether.fi Cash Card) is a crypto credit card from the Ethereum staking protocol ether.fi, built around a non-custodial wallet, staking yield and cash back on spending.

Tiers and rewards (compiled from a third-party article; ether.fi's official announcements prevail):

- **Core**: free; 3% cash back on the first $2,000 per month; 1 free virtual card, physical card $50.
- **Luxe**: unlocked with 5,000 spend points, $15,000 deposited in Liquid, 30,000 staked ETHFI or a $199 annual fee; 3% on the first $10,000 per month; 10% category cash back on selected subscriptions (capped at $10 per month); airport lounge single-entry vouchers twice a year; 2 free virtual cards and 1 free physical card.
- **Pinnacle**: unlocked with 25,000 spend points, $100,000 deposited in Liquid, 150,000 staked ETHFI or a $999 annual fee; 3% on the first $50,000 per month; 20% category cash back (capped at $20 per month); 10 free ATM withdrawals per month; unlimited lounge vouchers (one per day); a dedicated account manager.
- **VIP** (invitation only): 4% on the first $50,000 per month; 30% category cash back (capped at $30 per month); 10 free ATM withdrawals per month; dedicated support.

notes.zh-TW: 方案內容與回饋取自第三方文章（grenade.tw），可能隨時調整，請以 ether.fi 官方公告為準。加密資產與 DeFi 產品具有高度風險，可能損失本金；信用卡額度、費用與適用地區請自行確認，並遵守所在地法規。
notes.en: Tier details and rewards come from a third-party article (grenade.tw) and may change at any time; ether.fi's official announcements prevail. Crypto assets and DeFi products carry a high level of risk and you may lose your principal; check credit limits, fees and availability yourself, and follow local laws.

q.zh-TW: ether.fi Cash Card 有年費嗎？
q.en: Does the ether.fi Cash Card have an annual fee?

a.zh-TW: Core 方案免費。Luxe 可用年費 199 美元／年解鎖（也可用消費點數、存入 Liquid 或質押 ETHFI 解鎖），Pinnacle 為 999 美元／年。VIP 僅邀請制。
a.en: The Core tier is free. Luxe can be unlocked with a $199 annual fee (or with spend points, a Liquid deposit or staked ETHFI) and Pinnacle costs $999 a year. VIP is invitation only.
